newsitem.title: USA: Roy F. Weston names B. Robertson pres, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Roy F. Weston names B. Robertson pres, CEO.

text.p: Roy F. Weston Inc said Thursday it named Bill Robertson president and chief executive.
Robertson has been the company's acting president and CEO since late May.
He is also the chairman of the OneSoft Corp, a Virginia-based software development company.

On May 22, the company announced president and CEO William Marrazo resigned to provide the newly elected board "the maximum flexibility in its stated intention of redefining the company's strategy. At that time, the company's chief operating officer and chief financial officer also resigned for the same reasons. It recently named a replacement COO.
Weston is an international environmental services firm.
